content: Hyanna alamito kadhippete
Olan kachchi yin gidda abappa ye7e? Un ye7izanna yin ashto hyaarodes olinttize yin asho amoppa baane?
Yin amudhdhane, yezin denggoos; yinnii gisho, as wodhane. Mintstsii koyane, yezin denggodes dandda7oos; yinnii gisho, kacinttanen olinttane. Yin Xooz woossoose gisho koyze baz denggoos.
Yin woossane, yezin denggoos. Yin asho amuto folodes wobbo oge woossize gisho denggoos.
Yin, ammaninttoosuntso! Hyanna alamito kadhize Xoozara morkke maaqqizanno erosa? Hyanna alamttira igintsodes koyze ooden Xoozara morkke.
Geeshi Maxaafite, «Xoozii nu gidda yessade fana gaddide Ayyaanize, nu ees buzo maaqqade fana damma amudhdhane» gaydanna cer gaydebaz aazane?
Yezin Geeshi Maxaafite, «Xoozii uturtizuntsana ixxane, yezin fana toochizuntsis aadho keehatitsi inggane» yagaaze gisho Xoozii aadho keehatitsi gaantsi inggane.
Yinnii gisho, Xoozis aqote; Xalahera ixinttote; E yinttappa hyaakkoda.
Xoozago shiiqote; E yinttago shiiqoda. Yin, nagaranchchuntso, yin kushito meecote; lam77i qofa yezuntso, yin wozintto geeshote.
Azzanote, yeekkoten afuxxote. Yin miichita yeefora, yin ufayssita azzanora laamintto.
Laatstse tiino yinttanatitsito ziqii yiizote; E yinttana dhoqi dhoqi yiissada.
Firddippete

Ta ishuntso, fetay fetaya cazhippen zigirippete. Fa isha zigirizay eella afa firddize higge zigiranen higgella afa firddane. Ne higgella afa firddiko higgella afa firddizaya maaqqanep attin higge folizaya maaqqoos.
Higge inggizen firddize Xoozza xalaala. Ashshodesin dhabsodes dandda7ize eza. Yeezin, asalla afa firddizay ne oode?
Ceeqinttippete
Yin, «Nu hyayno woy wontta seko katama woy hyankko katama qitoda; ize fettii bere gam7oda; zal77i tirfisada» yaga7izuntso, si7ote.
Wontta akko hyanod yezako yin eroos. Yin de7ita wayadyezako erize oode? Yin eerats wode benttii dhabize qayqayo fana.
Yinno ashshii, «Laatstsi gayko nuunii yessada; hyanno woy yinno oochchoda» gawudes beezane.
Yezin yin hyatte uturanen ceeqinttane. Yinnii gaarize ceeqo ubba iita.
Yinnii gisho, lo77o baz oochchodes eriite oochchoose atstses yinna nagara.
